mostWorthwhile.text: Filtering the water was the most worthwhile moment because it showed that clearer water may still contain harmful microbes.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling and then covering the jar felt predictable, though both actions served the goal.

surprise.text: The hollow pipe became part of the water filter; its role in that assembly was not obvious to me.

arbitrary.text: The pipe's role in the filter felt a little unclear, although the offered combination led directly to a water filter.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see more practical systems assembled, though several steps here were predictable.
